title: Aesthetic Powerhouse: Width & Performance
author: Luka
desc:
Aesthetic Powerhouse is a 12-week hypertrophy and performance program designed for lifters whose main goal is an aesthetic, athletic physique rather than maximizing powerlifting totals.

The highest priorities are:

Maximum shoulder width through high-frequency side-delt training
Bigger arms and a stronger V-taper
Upper-chest and back development
Glute and hamstring specialization
Strong, developed abs and better trunk control
Maintaining quads without wasting recovery on unnecessary lower-body volume
Better muscular endurance and general work capacity
Front-loaded carrying and holding strength
Low-impact cardiovascular conditioning

The program uses 6 training days plus one short recovery/mobility day. Side-delt volume gradually increases across the training block because shoulder width is the main aesthetic specialization.

Lower-body training is intentionally posterior-chain dominant. Romanian deadlifts, hip thrusts, hamstring curls, back extensions and hip-abduction work prioritize glutes and hamstrings while leg-press volume is kept low for quad maintenance.

The program also includes core training across several functions: spinal flexion, anti-extension, loaded stabilization and controlled breathing/bracing. Carries, planks, push-ups and higher-rep glute work add practical strength and muscular endurance that traditional bodybuilding programs often neglect.

Progression is autoregulated using rep ranges and RPE. Instead of forcing weight increases every week, you add reps while staying within the prescribed RPE. Once you reach the top of the rep range on every set at the target RPE, increase the load and build back up again.

Weeks 5 and 10 reduce volume and intensity for recovery before the next progression phase.

Best suited for intermediate lifters
